summary: Request: scheduled encrypted SFTP audit bundles with per-field suppression and signed delivery manifest
description: Issue summary: Customer requests a recurring (daily) encrypted SFTP delivery of activity audit bundles that meet legal evidence requirements. Each bundle must include a signed delivery manifest (SHA256 checksums + per-file HMAC) and support per-field suppression rules (PII suppression for specified columns) configurable per-tenant. Impact: Compliance team at Neobank One must receive tamper-evident archives to satisfy regulatory legal-hold and SAR workflows. They cannot proceed with onboarding without this. Request details: - Delivery cadence: daily, 02:00 UTC - Payload: ndjson compressed (gz) bundles, one file per hour rolled into daily archive - Encryption: AES-256-GCM envelope; customer will provide public RSA key for asymmetric envelope; Redwood must sign manifest with platform signing key and include signature metadata - Field suppression: customer provided allowlist/denylist CSV mapping for fields to suppress or redact (e.g., user_email, full_text_prompt). Suppression must be deterministic and reversible for authorized legal requests (reversible pseudonymization) using HSM-backed KEK split approach. - Verification: customer needs instructions and a sample verification script and a signed manifest for every bundle. - Delivery: SFTP (jump-host) to customer hostname with mutual TLS client cert authentication. - Evidence: Need a short attestation package mapping how suppression was applied (playback hints) plus chain-of-custody timestamps. Point of contact: compliance@neobankone.com
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Validate existing export job SUP-21049 can produce a one-off audit bundle for tenant 'neobank-one' as a test. 2) Execute ad-hoc export for 2026-03-09 00:00-23:59 UTC using exports API (exports/v1/jobs) with parameters: tenant_id=neobank-one, schema=inference-audit-v2, suppression_profile=neobank-one-allowlist. 3) Confirm bundle appears in staging S3 path: s3://redwood-exports/staging/neobank-one/2026-03-09/ 4) Run decrypt+verify utility with customer test RSA private key against the created bundle and signed manifest. 5) Validate suppressed fields are replaced with deterministic pseudonyms and that reversible key metadata is present in manifest. 6) Deliver bundle to customer's SFTP test host and confirm LDAPS mTLS handshake completes.

investigation_notes: Checked manifest signing key chain: exports-signing-key-v2 is in use and rotated 2026-01-05 (KMS alias exports-signing-v2). Verified signature verification flow with local openssl verify against public cert stored in secrets manager.
SFTP handshake failures traced to missing intermediate CA on customer's gateway. Confirmed with packet captures (pcap) and TLS alert messages: certificate_unknown (40).

Field suppression pipeline: suppression_profile 'neobank-one-allowlist' applied as AVRO transform at transform-worker-14. Sampling of 10k rows showed 100% suppression of email and prompt columns and pseudonymized values use deterministic HMAC-SHA256 with tenant KEK reference kj-2025-88.

Reversibility plan: using HSM-backed KEK split; documented steps in Confluence page. Requires signed legal request and key-unseal workflow via support + security. Logged potential follow-up ticket to automate sealed-key rewraps for enterprise tenants.
Billing note: Daily delivery to SFTP will add outbound transfer line item; finance engagement recommended to add to customer's billing statement if enabled as managed delivery add-on.
resolution_notes: Workaround: Delivered sample encrypted bundle and signed manifest to customer's SFTP test host after CA rotation on 2026-03-11. Customer verified checksums and signature using provided verify script.

Fix / Implementation: 1) Created recurring export job template 'neobank-one-daily-encrypted' with cadence daily 02:00 UTC and suppression_profile set. 2) Configured SFTP endpoint with mutual TLS using provided client cert and uploaded platform client cert to customer's gateway as required. 3) Enabled manifest signing with exports-signing-key-v2; manifest includes per-file SHA256 and per-file HMAC (tenant-scoped). 4) Added an attestation envelope file (attestation.json) explaining suppression policy, pseudonymization algorithm, KEK reference, and chain-of-custody timestamps. 5) Opened follow-up INT ticket to automate key-unseal procedure for legal SAR retrievals.

Follow-up items: - INT-143300: Automate HSM key-unseal workflow with audit approvals. - Provide Neobank One with a quarterly key-rotation schedule and sample playbook for legal requests. - Finance to confirm managed delivery pricing by 2026-03-20.

Status: Customer accepted sample delivery on 2026-03-11; recurring delivery scheduled to start 2026-03-13. Marking this support request as In Progress until automation and finance confirmation are complete.
